slides.texte_overlay:
small things that make
people trust you instantly

showing your hands

people trust what they can see. keeping your hands open and visible when you talk is an old signal of honesty that the human brain still reacts to instantly.

knowing a little of everything

people relax around someone who can talk about anything. curiosity makes you easy to open up to, and it is honestly far simpler to build than most people think.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing a little of everything

i used to freeze in new conversations. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and people open up to me so much more easily.

slides.texte_overlay:
admitting small mistakes

saying i got that wrong without fuss makes everything else you say more believable. people trust someone who is honest about the little things first and foremost.

remembering names

use someone's name early and correctly. it shows you paid attention from the very first moment, and people instantly feel safer with someone who listens.

doing what you said

if you say you'll send it tomorrow, send it tomorrow. small promises kept on time build more trust than any big speech or grand gesture ever really could.
